detachments.name: Shadowmark Talon

rule.name: Shadow Tactics
rule.rules_text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have Stealth. Friendly PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD units have -3 inches detection range. Friendly AETHON SHAAN units have Unparalleled Tactician: once per battle round, per army, when you use the Into Darkness Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

restrictions: Your army can include RAVEN GUARD units, but it cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Blackwing Shroud
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. This unit has Infiltrators and -3 inches detection range.

enhancements.name: Umbral Raptor
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. This model has Fights First and Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Instincts
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an Ingress move.

enhancements.name: Coronal Sussurrant
enhancements.rules_text: PHOBOS model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with this unit cannot be targeted by controlling player's Stratagems.

stratagems.name: Into Darkness
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Raptorial Vigilance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8 inches of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if it is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

stratagems.name: Murderous Fusillade
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made an Ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have +1 BS and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Suppressed Weapons
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.name: Feint and Thrust
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: The Tactical Doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Lay Low the Tyrants
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

abilities.name: Master of Shadows
abilities.rules_text: In your Command phase, select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. That unit can re-roll Charge rolls until the start of your next Command phase.

abilities.name: Blackwing Mantle
abilities.rules_text: Once per phase, per army, you can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for -1CP, regardless of other uses, and that use does not prevent further uses.

abilities.name: Trifold Path of Shadow
abilities.rules_text: This unit has Stealth and -3 inches detection range.

abilities.name: Echo of the Ravenspire
abilities.rules_text: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in Strategic Reserves.

can_lead: Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs
leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to Assault Intercessors with Jump Packs and Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs units.
